name: comp-361
title: Stats Tooltip
description: An outlined Stats button reveals a compact tooltip listing four build metrics. Each row puts a muted label above a bold value, from status to coverage and performance score.
use: A tight space needs to show a few labelled figures on demand without a full dashboard.
avoid: Values are hardcoded in the tooltip, so live stats require rewriting the source.
a11y: Focus opens the tooltip and the rows use a real list with readable text; there is no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: At rest a small outlined Stats button sits centred in a bordered card with a caption. On hover a light tooltip opens above it, stacking four short metric blocks: a grey label on one line and a bold value below, spaced generously apart.
behaves: Hovering or focusing Stats opens the tooltip immediately and moving away closes it. The values are fixed; nothing else changes.
customise: The four metric labels and values are fixed in the tooltip's list, so changing them means editing the source; the trigger text is fixed too.
weight: light: A button and a four-row popup; no charts or animation loop.
demo: Caption 'Hover for build stats.'; tooltip shows status Completed, coverage 94.3%, last deploy today 15:42, score 98/100.
issues: Metrics are hardcoded, so the tooltip cannot show live build data without code changes.
polishWhy: Tidy, legible stat list; a plain standard tooltip demo with fixed data.
